pericopes.title: Fear God, Not People
pericopes.imageAlt: Morning fog dissolving to reveal a stone wall, the wall fully visible in one patch of clearing and hidden in mist elsewhere

pericopes.title: The Rich Fool
pericopes.imageAlt: A large clay storage jar cracked open on a stone floor, grain spilling out and scattering, the crack running from top to base

pericopes.title: Do Not Worry
pericopes.imageAlt: Wild grass and a single small wildflower in late afternoon golden light, a feather resting nearby on the ground

pericopes.title: Servants Who Wait
pericopes.imageAlt: Several lit oil lamps in a dark interior arranged in a row on a stone ledge, the darkness beyond them absolute

pericopes.title: Not Peace But Division
pericopes.imageAlt: A stone surface with a single deep fissure running the full length of the frame, one side slightly higher than the other, harsh noon light

pericopes.title: Reading the Time
pericopes.imageAlt: Storm clouds building on a horizon over flat land, a small patch of blue sky still visible, the light changing quality
